corrections.reason: Latin OCR artifact 'ri' for the printed Ethiopic Fidel ፄ in the traditional Amharic term በበጎባፄ (ባፄ = ባርያ/አገልጋይ).
The printed glyph is 6th-order ር (ባርያ) without a 3rd-order bottom leg.
In the canonical Ge'ez citation (ተጋቢአ ትከውን አሐተ ጵርስፎራ) and in the printed image, the final letter of ተጋቢአ is 1st-order አ (feminine adverbial/gerundive), not 6th-order እ.
